name: bracket_closure
description: Complete the final missing closing bracket in a balanced nested delimiter string; matched controls copy an internal letter.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]; pairs={'(':')','[':']','{':'}'}
for i in range(100):
 opens=[random.choice(list(pairs)) for _ in range(random.randrange(1,5))]; letter=random.choice(list('abcxyz')); full=''.join(opens)+letter+''.join(pairs[o] for o in opens[::-1]); s=full[:-1]
 items.append({'prompt':'Write only the missing final closing bracket.
(a -> )
[b -> ]
{(c) -> }
'+s+' ->','answer':' '+full[-1]})
 control.append({'prompt':'Write only the letter inside the brackets.
(a -> a
[b -> b
{(c) -> c
'+s+' ->','answer':' '+letter})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
